name: Exp_Fractal_Force_Index
summary: This EA trades based on the combination of Fractal breakouts and Force Index momentum signals. It enters long positions when price breaks above a fractal high with confirming positive Force Index, and enters short positions on fractal low breakouts with negative Force Index. The strategy aims to capture momentum-driven moves confirmed by both price structure and volume-weighted force.
summary_zh: 该EA基于分形突破和强力指数动量信号的组合进行交易。当价格突破分形高点且强力指数为正时做多，当价格跌破分形低点且强力指数为负时做空。该策略旨在捕捉由价格结构和成交量加权动力共同确认的动量驱动行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是将比尔·威廉姆斯的分形指标与强力指数相结合，利用分形识别关键价格突破点，同时用强力指数确认突破的方向性动量强度。入场条件为：做多需价格收盘高于最近上分形且强力指数为正值，做空需价格收盘低于最近下分形且强力指数为负值。出场条件通常包括反向分形突破信号、强力指数反转穿越零轴、或固定止损止盈目标。仓位管理方面，从文件名判断采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，具体取决于参数设置。资金管理方面，由于策略依赖分形突破，需要设置合理的止损以防止假突破造成较大亏损。该策略适合趋势明显的市场环境，在震荡市中可能因频繁的假分形突破而产生较多虚假信号和连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept combines Bill Williams' Fractal indicator with the Force Index, using fractals to identify key price breakout levels while the Force Index confirms the directional momentum strength of the breakout. Entry conditions: long positions require price closing above the nearest upper fractal with a positive Force Index, while short positions require price closing below the nearest lower fractal with a negative Force Index. Exit conditions typically include an opposing fractal breakout signal, Force Index reversal crossing the zero line, or fixed stop-loss and take-profit targets. Position sizing likely uses either fixed lots or a percentage-based calculation depending on the input parameters configured by the user. Money management requires reasonable stop-losses since the strategy depends on fractal breakouts, which can produce false signals causing significant losses if not properly managed. The strategy performs best in trending markets and may generate numerous false signals with consecutive losses in ranging or choppy market conditions due to frequent invalid fractal breakouts.

pros: 双指标组合过滤假信号，分形确认价格结构突破，强力指数确认动量方向，降低虚假突破入场概率
分形指标自适应市场波动，无需手动调整支撑阻力位，策略对不同市场条件具有一定适应性
逻辑清晰直观，入场条件明确可量化，便于回测验证和参数优化
强力指数包含成交量信息，比纯价格指标更能反映市场真实参与度
pros_en: Dual-indicator combination filters false signals effectively — fractals confirm price structure breakouts while Force Index confirms momentum direction, reducing invalid breakout entries
Fractal indicator is self-adaptive to market volatility without requiring manual support/resistance level adjustment, providing some adaptability across different market conditions
Clear and intuitive logic with quantifiable entry conditions that are easy to backtest and optimize
Force Index incorporates volume information, reflecting real market participation better than pure price-based indicators
cons: 分形指标具有滞后性，分形需要至少2根K线确认才能形成，入场时最佳价位往往已经过去
在震荡行情中分形频繁形成和突破，强力指数也容易在零轴附近反复振荡，导致频繁开平仓和手续费磨损
缺少止损的默认设置（常见默认值为0）可能导致单笔亏损过大，风险控制不足
未考虑点差和滑点影响，在短线分形突破交易中点差成本可能显著侵蚀利润
cons_en: Fractal indicator is inherently lagging — a fractal requires at least 2 confirming bars to form, meaning the optimal entry price has often already passed by the time the signal is confirmed
In ranging markets, fractals form and break frequently while Force Index oscillates around zero, leading to excessive trade frequency and commission drain
Default stop-loss value of 0 (common in such EAs) can lead to excessive single-trade losses with insufficient risk control
Spread and slippage impacts are not accounted for, which can significantly erode profits in short-term fractal breakout trading
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈机制，根据市场波动率自适应调整止损距离，避免固定点数止损在不同波动环境下失效
增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线），仅在趋势明确时交易分形突破，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
增加最大回撤限制和每日最大交易次数限制，防止极端行情下过度交易和资金快速回撤
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism that adapts to market volatility, avoiding the failure of fixed-pip stops across different volatility regimes
Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher-timeframe moving average) to trade fractal breakouts only when a clear trend exists, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Add maximum drawdown limits and daily maximum trade count restrictions to prevent overtrading and rapid capital drawdown during extreme market conditions

risk_points: 分形突破信号滞后可能导致入场价位不佳，止损距离需要较大才能避免被正常回扫扫出
缺少默认止损设置时，假突破可能导致大幅亏损
震荡市中连续假信号可能导致频繁小额亏损累积成显著回撤
强力指数参数不当可能导致动量确认失真，入场时机偏离
risk_points_en: Lagging fractal breakout signals may result in suboptimal entry prices, requiring wider stop-losses to avoid being stopped out by normal price retracements
Without default stop-loss settings, false breakouts can lead to large single-trade losses
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets can accumulate small losses into significant drawdowns
Improper Force Index parameter settings may distort momentum confirmation, leading to mistimed entries
